description: Mediation Boards Commission - Invites nominations for the appointment of Mediators for the  Administrative Districts of Colombo, Kandy, Matale, Hambanthota, Kurunegala & Puttalam
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial officers (mediators) to serve on mediation panels across various districts, operating under the Mediation Boards Act. This fits Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement) as it deals with the appointment of quasi-judicial officers and the administration of alternative dispute resolution mechanisms within the legal system.
